scenes.heading: Keep your links organized and tagged by source

sents.d: Keep your links organized and tagged by source
If you can't see which post earned a sale, you'll keep making content that doesn't sell.
Without tracking, every commission is a mystery.
You can't tell which video or post deserves more of your time.
Keep your links on one page, and give each one a SubID for its platform and post.
Review clicks by SubID weekly and make more of what converts.

take: One home for your links and a tag on every one shows you what really sells.
